scope: Development study only: inherited 24 train actors and 6 historically exposed validation actors. No original test, eight-actor reevaluation or 1019 inputs are used.
change: Train-only candidate selection with genuinely nested actor exclusion; use regularized logistic probabilities without pooled OOF calibration; fixed motion temporal-DCT descriptor as additional video candidate.
folds: Outer four actor folds and inner three actor folds, fixed sorted-actor round-robin assignment; every encoder held actor excluded from fitting and candidate selection.
selection: Minimum actor-fold OOF binary log loss, then feature order and C order; no validation selection.
relation_fitting: Separately trained ordinary logistic heads C=1 on seven polynomial probability features, with masked modalities exactly 0.5; same nested OOF audio and text probabilities.
increment: Paired per-actor accuracy and Brier AVT minus AT, with development-only actor bootstrap 95% intervals, 10000 draws seed 20261101.
negative_control: Permute video across episodes within each validation actor, same frozen AVT head, 100 predeclared permutations seed 20261102; descriptive mechanism diagnostic only.
video_gate: Video sentence accuracy >=0.9 and development paired AVT-AT accuracy lower bound >0; even if met this is not independent population qualification.
